This incident was triggered by a sudden crowd surge as rain fell, causing panic among waiting devotees. Authorities, including police and disaster management teams, have been deployed to assist the injured.

Eyewitnesses recounted scenes of distress, with numerous individuals fainting under the circumstances. Emergency services acted quickly, transporting the seriously injured to Calcutta Medical College.

title: Vaidehi Chandrasekar, 72, wins global nature photography gold for giraffe shot

The imagery beautifully illustrates the giraffe's fluid movements, enhanced by the shimmering sunlight on the water's surface. Since retiring in 2019, Chandrasekar has dedicated her passion to wildlife photography, striving to promote conservation efforts through her award-winning work, including a prestigious gold award at the 2026 World Nature Photography Awards.

title: Martha’s Vineyard rejects 54-acre housing plan after seven marathon meetings
content: Martha's Vineyard's planning board has turned down the Katama Meadows housing initiative after thorough discussions. This project sought to meet housing demands through a mix of affordable and market-rate homes catering to essential workers. However, environmental concerns regarding nitrogen pollution and the inclusion of luxury properties raised significant opposition, leading to the decision. The land remains with the developers, who may consider a revised proposal in the future.

title: 25 years after closing, ex-McClellan base draws $600M investment
content: Following its shutdown in 2001, McClellan Air Force Base prompted worries about economic decline. However, the area has been revitalized with McClellan Park, which boasts a $600 million investment and encompasses 10 million square feet of facilities. The site now functions as a public-use regional hub, enhancing local transportation and offering significant employment opportunities, while also emphasizing environmental restoration initiatives since the base's closure.

title: USCIS: Anyone who ‘guarantees’ a faster visa or Green Card is scamming you
content: USCIS warns immigrants and visa applicants about fraudulent schemes that promise quicker visa approvals in exchange for monetary fees. These scams frequently involve false claims of having special ties to government officials. USCIS insists that no one can hasten the immigration process through personal connections. Individuals should file applications independently and trust assistance only from recognized professionals. Recognizing fraudulent emails and suspicious offers is essential to protect against these scams.

title: Drone LiDAR finds 3 unregistered Aboriginal rock shelters in Australian bushland
content: Researchers utilized drone technology to discover three previously unregistered Aboriginal rock shelters in the Blue Mountains region, revealing significant cultural heritage. Collaboration with the Dharug Custodian Aboriginal Corporation ensured accurate documentation of red hand stencils and stone artifacts. This innovative approach may improve archaeological surveys in difficult-to-navigate areas, thereby preserving cultural heritage. Ongoing efforts will assess the method's applicability to different Australian landscapes, ensuring continued protection.

title: Why Trump's plan to unleash 'Mother Of All Bombs' may fall flat in Iran
content: Military discussions are considering the use of the MOAB against Iran's nuclear facilities and military targets. However, the effectiveness of the MOAB is limited against deeply buried sites protected by reinforced concrete. Analysts highlight that the GBU-57 penetrator is better suited for such underground facilities, which require specialized weapons for effective targeting. While the MOAB has a strong psychological impact, its military utility against hardened targets is questionable.

title: ‘Taking away right to vote, protest’: Uddhav backs opposition's ‘regime change’ call
content: uddhav Thackeray questioned the deployment of a large number of police personnel in Delhi during protests called by the Cockroach Janta Party . he said those who claim to have brought Ram are scared of cockroaches .

title: Cars torched, shops looted: Violence protests erupt across France; over 270 arrested
content: more than 270 people arrested across france as protests over rising living costs turned violent . cars set ablaze, shops looted, and police used tear gas and water cannons . videos from Paris showed protesters climbing a statue to unfurl an anti-police banner .

title: Imagine Sisyphus posting: The absurd economics of India’s creator boom
content: the creator economy is booming, but for millions of aspiring creators, turning online visibility into a sustainable livelihood remains an elusive promise . one must imagine the creator successful, but is success within reach of everyone who has been promised a shot at it? in a world where almost everyone has some form of digital access to social media, is the creation economy truly sustainable or even democratised?

title: 'Do something. You can’t die like this': Capt Smit Machchar recounts flydubai attack
content: 'there was a moment I told myself, Smit, do something, you can’t die like this,' said the flydubai commander . he recounted the sept 30 terror attack on flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv . the flight was diverted and landed in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia .

title: Pope Leo walks out of hospital 4 days after lung cancer surgery
content: leo XIV greeted patients inside the hospital before walking unaided to his waiting vehicle . he also briefly stopped when a teenage girl presented him with a homemade papal doll . the pope was expected to deliver the traditional angelus blessing on Sunday from a window overlooking St Peter’s Square .

title: Blind UK man rejected from 1,000 jobs builds business, wins King’s Trust award
content: Brandon Hulcoop faced rejection after rejection while trying to find work . the 23-year-old turned his frustration into a business aimed at making everyday experiences more accessible for people with sight loss . he developed the confidence and practical skills to pursue an idea of his own, eventually leading to the creation of All Things Dotty .

title: 19 killed in Kolkata stampede; CM Suvendu announces jobs, Rs 25 lakh for kin
content: a fact-finding committee will be constituted to investigate the incident . the state government will also bear the entire cost of medical treatment for the injured . 19 people have lost their lives, 17 of whom died on the spot, the chief minister says .

title: Legal profession is not for faint-hearted: CJI Surya Kant at NLSIU
content: two months after students opposed CJI Surya Kant’s presence at the campus, he attended the convocation . he said the legal profession demands intellectual independence coupled with fairness and hearing a person before judging .

title: For second time in a week, Dipke released on bail on condition of keeping peace
content: abhijeet Dipke and Neha Bora were detained from mandi house and taken to police station . she was released after submitting a written undertaking to maintain peace and tranquillity for one year . Dipke was granted bail and released after completion of formalities under Section 65 of Delhi Police Act .

title: What’s the need for MEA to study ‘functional role’ of Mann visit: HC
content: govt had moved HC after the meA 'denied' its plea for clearance . court said it had not explained the political angle it cited . the court said the court has not explained what that political angle/viewpoint is .

title: 'War booty': Cheap iPhone 18s advertised in Tehran after Hormuz shipwreck
content: sellers claim the devices were recovered from a cargo ship that sank near the strategic waterway on October 13 . videos purportedly showed shipping containers floating in the sea, with iPhones and expensive perfumes scattered in the water . there has been no confirmation of the incidencia .
